🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.47% | 1M: +0.21%) and XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -5.46%) show near-term weakness while XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +3.99%) provide offsetting strength, supporting the neutral read.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit neutral: HYG (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION implies HYG/LQD → flat. Fear modestly easing: VXX (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -6.27%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Commodities/energy strength (BNO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +15.22%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising) is a key tailwind.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall; TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -3.21%) points to modest yield pressure ↓ falling while dollar and curve indicators are flat → neutral.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%) ↑ rising. Healthcare steady: XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +7.74%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -5.46%) ↓ falling — style: favor cyclicals/value over growth on breadth confirmation.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.47% | 1M: +0.21%). China showing pockets of strength: FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +3.99%), while EM EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -7.70%) lags.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.98% | 1M: +5.76%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.69% | 1M: +0.32%) show appetite, but ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -3.11%) signals selective risk-taking.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity-strength: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.57% | 1M: +1.72%) and multiple energy/commodity ETFs (USO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND) are rising ↑. Gold in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -3.18%) RECOVERY — safe-haven demand mixed.

8. Energy Trend?
XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%) ↑ rising; crude-focused BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +15.22%) confirms. Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -11.41%) ↓ falling.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: broad sector breadth (8/11) and commodity/energy leadership (XLE, BNO) support risk-neutral bias; notable divergences include XBI CORRECTION (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +9.90%) and multiple 1W/1M mismatches (CIBR, XLF) — monitor for momentum fade.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/value exposures (XLE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION) and reduce exposure to weaker tech (XLK (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -5.46%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND); maintain neutral duration posture (TLT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -3.21%) BELOW TREND).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare — XLV (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +7.74%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology — XLK (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -5.46%) BELOW TREND; Materials — XME (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -13.12%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Brent/Crude — BNO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +15.22%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +12.17%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas — UNG (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -11.41%) BELOW TREND; silver SLV (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), SPY short-term support near recent 1W low (monitor CORRECTION), XLK/XLF spread as a watchpoint for style rotation.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, with energy and select cyclicals showing strength while tech and utilities lag. Favor cyclicals/value exposure (XLE, XLF) and monitor tech divergences (XLK, QQQ) and commodity-driven risk flows.
